response.sql:
WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb,
        AVG(APTT - PT) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE UA > 3.9
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_hgb) AS average_patient_avg_hgb,
    AVG(avg_aptt_minus_pt) AS average_patient_avg_aptt_minus_pt
FROM per_patient;

assumptions.assumption: “Elevated” means UA > 3.9, and each patient contributes equally to the across-patient averages. SQL aggregates ignore NULL values; records with NULL UA are excluded by the filter.
